descriptionHtml:
Premium 10'×20' Custom Canopy Tent

Built for serious vendors and outdoor professionals, our Premium 10'×20' Custom Canopy Tent delivers durability, stability, and full visual impact. Featuring a 40mm heavy-duty aluminum frame, fully customizable 600D dye-sublimated canopy, and complete weather protection, this setup is ideal for trade shows, festivals, food booths, and branded outdoor events.

Includes a wheeled carry bag for easy transport and free nationwide FedEx ground shipping.

Features

🛡️ Durable 600D Polyester Canopy: Weather-resistant, long-lasting outdoor fabric.
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation: Your artwork is printed in vibrant, high-resolution detail.
💪 Heavy-Duty Aluminum Frame: Constructed with 1.2 mm anodized aluminum.
🔩 Reinforced ABS Hardware: ABS glass-filled nylon joints for added frame strength.
📏 1.75" HEX Legs: Hexagon-shaped legs for enhanced stability.
⬆️ Pinch-Free Adjustment: Plastic lever system for smooth height changes.
🧳 Easy Transport: Collapses to fit inside the included soft wheeled carry bag.
🪢 Secure Setup: Includes stake and rope kit; tent must be anchored to maintain warranty.
🖨️ Imprint Method: Premium full-color dye sublimation.

Product Dimensions

📐 Product Size: 120" W × 137" H × 120" D
📦 Collapsible Size: 9.12" W × 62.75" H × 9.12" D
🎒 Case Dimensions: 12.5" W × 56.25" H × 15.5" D
⚖️ Product Weight: 40 lbs

Kit Includes

🧩 1× Frame Hardware
🎪 1× Custom Printed Canopy
🧱 1× Full Back Wall (Single-Sided)
🧩 2× Half Side Walls (Single-Sided)
🧳 1× Wheeled Carry Bag
🪢 1× Ropes & Pegs Set

Optional Accessories

6' Table Cover
Feather Flags
Sandbags

Materials

🔧 Hardware: ABS Nylon, Aluminum
🧵 Canopy Fabric: 600D Polyester

Certifications

🔥 Meets FR Rating Requirements

Primary Usage

Outdoor events, vendor booths, markets, trade shows, festivals, brand activations, and corporate setups.

Factory Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
